scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run server" "npm run worker" "npm run scheduler"
scripts.screenshot:analyze: tsx -e "import { screenshotService } from './src/services/screenshotService'; const stats = screenshotService.getErrorStats(); console.log('📊 Error Screenshot Statistics:', JSON.stringify(stats, null, 2))"
scripts.screenshot:report: tsx -e "import { screenshotService } from './src/services/screenshotService'; const path = screenshotService.generateErrorReport(); console.log('✅ Error report generated at:', path); console.log('Open in browser to view all error screenshots')"
scripts.screenshot:clean: tsx -e "import { screenshotService } from './src/services/screenshotService'; const count = screenshotService.clearOldScreenshots(30); console.log('✅ Cleaned up', count, 'old screenshots')"
scripts.screenshot:list: tsx -e "import { screenshotService } from './src/services/screenshotService'; const screenshots = screenshotService.getErrorScreenshots(); console.log('📸 Error Screenshots:', screenshots.length); screenshots.slice(0, 10).forEach(s => console.log('  -', s.filename, s.metadata?.timestamp))"
